title: Warm Cheesy Polish Sausages Casserole
description: A quick and delicious Polish dish featuring Italian fennel sausages and a cheesy, mustardy sauce, made vegan-friendly with plant-based cheese and sausage options. This casserole is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the Italian fennel sausages in a pan with olive oil over medium heat until browned.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a separate bowl, mix together the mustard, shio-koji cure, salt, and black pepper.
Add the mustard mixture to the pan with the sausages and onion, and stir to combine.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of sausages and onion mixture.
Top the sausages with a layer of vegan cheese shreds.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
